name: Yellow Legacy Changes
description: Yellow Legacy by TSP changes: buffed/nerfed moves, rebalanced stats, trade evolutions become level evolutions, rebalanced trainer and gym-leader teams (rival Eevee replaced by the starter lines: Bulbasaur for Jolteon, Charmander for Flareon, Squirtle for Vaporeon), Ghost special + super-effective vs Psychic, a MODS-menu toggle for Dragon physical, an optional HARD MODE (Set style, no items in battle, badge-gated level caps -- offered when starting a new game and toggleable in the OPTIONS menu), and the Crystal Tear post-game quest: Oak gifts the key item after the Hall of Fame with 150 species caught, and using it in Cerulean Cave B1F after Mewtwo reveals a level-75 Mew.
